event.title: DHS Secretary Mullin Supports Trump's Claims of Election Interference
event.canonical_title: DHS Secretary Mullin Supports Trump's Claims of Election Interference
event.summary: DHS Secretary Mullin has reiterated President Trump's allegations of foreign interference in US elections, particularly targeting China for purported election meddling. In a recent primetime address, Trump emphasized his belief in significant vulnerabilities within the US election system, although experts have disputed these claims and noted that documents he referenced suggest the systems are difficult to manipulate.

timeline.title: Trump Claims China Interfered in 2020 Election During National Address
timeline.summary: In a recent address, the US president revived allegations of election interference, claiming that China had unlawfully obtained 220 million US voter files. He stated his intention to declassify intelligence data supporting these claims. However, these assertions contradict previous reviews that found no substantial evidence of interference in the 2020 election.
key_facts: Trump claimed China acquired 220 million US voter files.
He plans to declassify intelligence data related to these claims.
Previous reviews found no significant evidence of election interference.
